lines.text: The outfit for tomorrow is sorted. Your face is a separate project.
I've planned tomorrow's outfit down to the hour. Your hair still has a mind of its own.
Weather-wise, it'll be fine. I can't speak for the rest of you.
Good news: the outfit is sorted. Bad news: you're still in it.
Wet hair tomorrow. A new look for you. Not an improvement, but new.
You'll blame the rain for how you look. For once, that'll be half true.
One more layer tomorrow. A lot of fabric for very little payoff.
Bundled up, you'll look like a parcel nobody ordered.
A one-outfit day. Even you can't get that wrong. Probably.
The same outfit from morning to night. Bold, given the outfit.
Warmer tomorrow. I asked for that weeks ago. Glad someone reads my mail.
Warmer tomorrow. I'd celebrate, but I'm a screen. This is me celebrating.
Warmer. Don't tell the weather I said this, but thanks.
Warmer tomorrow. Don't get attached.
Rain in the morning, then gone. I asked for the reverse. Nobody listens.
Lovely. It's leaving.
The rain leaves early. Nobody say anything, or it'll come back.
Nothing changes tomorrow. I asked for a little drama. Denied.
Nothing happens tomorrow. I tried to book some weather. Fully booked elsewhere.
A one-outfit day. I'd complain, but I'm saving it for when it matters.
One outfit, all day. Lovely. Nothing to report.
